label: Delivery Model
title: How work moves from research to delivery.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: Clarify the problem, the constraints, the buyer, and the expected value of the engagement.

steps.title: Prototype or Pilot
steps.description: Build a narrow system that proves the approach and exposes technical or operational risk early.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.description: Integrate the system into the customer environment with the right controls, interfaces, and evaluation.

steps.title: Iteration
steps.description: Refine the system based on real usage, measurable outcomes, and changing requirements.
